{{Top|leg}}
The '''Republic Army Research Division''' was a division of the [[Republic Army]] that was worked on scientific research and advancements. When a cache of [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] in [[Hazard Vault 451]] in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] was uncovered by [[Havoc Squad]] and [[Tanno Vik]], the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc CO]] chose to have the cache delivered to the Balmorran people rather than the Research Divison.<ref name="Den of Thieves">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|Den of Thieves|[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref>
